en.t: That day, the wind was favorable.

units.source_text: 舍舟登陆，乘车到达京都，不曾延误时日。

en.t: They left the boat, went ashore, and traveled by carriage to Kyoto without losing any time.

units.source_text: 为欲避免外人议论，一路上谨慎小心。

en.t: To avoid gossip from outsiders, they were careful and discreet throughout the journey.
